--White-2 is another paint style named White (#FFF); --White is not used here: they are two styles, keep each where the layer names it.
#FFF is written raw 2 times (background of 1:3, background of 1:7) and equals --White-2: use the token.
#F00 is written raw 2 times (background of 1:4, border of 1:7) and equals --Accent: use the token.
2 layers keep Figma's default names (1:2 "Frame 12", 1:4 "Rectangle 7"): name the elements by their role in the code.

A frame has no auto layout, so its children are placed absolutely (1:2 "Frame 12" with 2 children, Figma reads it as display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 10px 0 0 10px; align-items: center; gap: 8px): build them as a flow if they are meant to resize.
A rectangle covers its parent under the content (1:3 "Backdrop" covers 1:2 "Frame 12"): write each as its parent's background, not as an element.
A frame only wraps one layer (1:5 "Wrapper" only wraps 1:6): they may not need elements of their own.

line-height normal is Figma's Auto line height: the font's own spacing, about 1.2× the font size for most fonts (1:6 "Note"; I1:9;2:1 "Label"); give it in px where the build must match to the pixel (inspect shows each text's).

is a line break inside a paragraph (Shift+Enter in Figma,
in HTML), not spaces (1:6 "Note").

A layer has a stroke centred on its edge (1:7 "Card"): Figma paints half of it outside the box, a CSS border all inside; where it must match to the pixel, use an outline with outline-offset of minus half its width.
A frame was detached from a component (1:8 "Detached card"): check whether the component fits instead.

A layer is wider or taller than the room their auto layout parent gives them, so they overflow it in Figma too (1:8 "Detached card" 500px wide in 400px): decide whether the build wraps, clips or lets them out.
A layer inside an instance differs from its component outside its properties (I1:9;2:1 "Label": color): give the component a property or a variant for them, or build them as one-offs.
Fonts missing on this machine (Inter) in I1:9;2:1 "Label": Figma could not lay these texts out, so their sizes may be off.
gap 16px on 1 layer (1:10 "Stack") matches --space-16, Figma's own match for that field: use the token.
